name: Three Corners
summary: At Three Corners, roads meet at the western edge of the Redridge Mountains. The routes link Goldshire, Lakeshire, and Darkshire, while Stormwind guards watch for gnolls threatening travelers and supply wagons.

sections.title: A Crossroads of Three Shires
sections.body: At Three Corners, three roads link the southern settlements of Stormwind. Goldshire lies west in Elwynn Forest, Lakeshire northeast in Redridge, and Darkshire south in Duskwood. Stormwind built Tower Watch at the junction, where guards and scouts try to keep the roads clear. Gnolls from Redridge threaten travelers and supply wagons moving between the regions.

faq.q: Why is this place called Three Corners?
faq.answer: Three roads lead from the crossroads toward Goldshire in Elwynn Forest, Lakeshire in Redridge, and Darkshire in Duskwood. Together, these are the Three Shires of southern Stormwind.

faq.q: Who guards the tower at Three Corners?
faq.answer: Members of the Stormwind Guard man Tower Watch. The post warns of danger and helps defend against gnolls coming down from the Redridge peaks toward the Elwynn border.

faq.q: What threats are active around Three Corners?
faq.answer: Gnolls from the surrounding hills prowl the roads and ambush travelers and couriers. Guards call on passing adventurers to thin the packs and keep the roads passable.

angles.text: For Alliance travelers leaving Elwynn Forest, Three Corners is the first fortified outpost. Stormwind's hold on its borderlands is stretched thin.
As a human, you pass through a junction that links the southern human heartlands. Couriers and traders travel between Elwynn, Duskwood, and Redridge.
